items: HDFC Bank launched **'Max for Seniors'** and **'Max for Her'** savings account variants with auto-sweep and accidental death cover on debit card up to **₹3.19 crore**.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
